**L1 verdict (L1-a): REWORK — regenerate after #37785 merges** at head `b234dce486ba3ad6a23d4408b921a2a38e195464` (card #37733). Read · 2026-11-27T04:44Z

**The diff is right for today's main.** One README cell, the ADR-0160 status, regenerated by `node scripts/adr-index.mjs`. I ran `--check` on `origin/main` (exit 1) and regenerated it: the result is byte-identical to this head's cell, and no other row moves. Checks are green.

**But it goes stale the moment #37785 lands.** #37785 (Tier H, at seat handoff now) edits ADR-0160's `**Status**:` line for its fifth and sixth amendments. I regenerated the index on #37785's tree: the cell becomes "…amended 2026-11-25, 2…", not this head's "…amended 2026-11-25 an…". I also merged this head with #37785 and ran `--check`: exit 1. The CI step is report-only (`adr-index-current-report-only` in `lint.yml`), so nothing reds, but the card's goal (an index that matches the records) would be undone by the next merge. Both PRs need a human approval, so landing this one first spends an approval on a cell that is stale on arrival.

**Owed.** Once #37785 is on main, merge main into this branch, re-run `node scripts/adr-index.mjs`, and send the new head. On that head I run the L1 delta and the contract-tier record together (`docs/adr/**` owes it). Running it now would only be redone.

**The footer deviation.** The harness footer in place of the os-dev rule-line footer has no effect on the diff or any gate. No rewrite needed.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `49760721cab5af6eaf11bea6c280f7f9588c8920`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/README.md + none
Security-touching: no

PR #37812 for card #37733. Net diff against `main`: one file, `docs/adr/README.md`, +1 / -1, the status cell of the ADR-0160 row (line 230). Read from the tree with git; nothing was built or run. `scripts/adr-index.mjs` and the ADR-0160 record are outside the diff and were read, not reviewed.

### ① Derived judgments

- **The cell is the generator's projection of the record: right.** On this head the ADR-0160 `**Status**:` line begins `Accepted — merged 2026-11-24 (PR [objectstack#37115](…)); amended 2026-11-25, 2026-11-26 and 2026-11-27 (see **Amended** below).` `statusCell()` in `scripts/adr-index.mjs` takes the plain text (link reduced to its text), removes the keyword `Accepted` and the leading dash, and passes the rest to `cell(detail, 64)`, which keeps 63 characters, trims and appends the ellipsis. The first 63 characters of the detail are `merged 2026-11-24 (PR objectstack#37115); amended 2026-11-25, 2` (counted by hand: 7 + 10 + 1 + 3 + 1 + 17 + 2 + 1 + 7 + 1 + 10 + 1 + 1 + 1). The committed cell is `Accepted — merged 2026-11-24 (PR objectstack#37115); amended 2026-11-25, 2…`: identical.
- **The other five cells of the row are unchanged: right.** Link, title, date `2026-11-24` and the two dash cells are the same on both sides of the hunk; the record's title and `Date` field did not move.
- **No other row moves: right.** The diff has one hunk. Since the last index write on `main` (972114df) only two records changed, ADR-0150 and ADR-0160; the ADR-0150 change touches no title, status, date or supersedes line, and the ADR-0160 change touches the status line alone. The generator is unchanged. So this row is the only one the generator can print differently. The dev's `node scripts/adr-index.mjs --check` exit 0 on this head (report 7211137072) agrees; it was not re-run here.
- **Still current against today's `main`: right.** The PR base is c826e8a156 and `main` is now 9b50fedbfa. Nothing under `docs/adr/`, `ui/docs/adr/` or `scripts/adr-index.mjs` differs between the two, and the ADR-0160 record and the generator are byte-identical on this head and on `main`. The L1 REWORK (7210061635, regenerate after #37785) is met by this head.
- **No accept-set or public-surface change.** A generated documentation index; no schema, no code, no gate.

Gate verdicts, from the 44 check-runs on this head: every one is `success` or `skipped`, none failed or pending. Required contexts read by name: Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Test UI, Dogfood Regression Gate and Governed Surface Queue Guard are `success`. The index check inside the lint job is report-only by ruling, so its green is not by itself proof of a current index; the judgment above rests on the tree.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no` on the PR body and on the claim: right. `skip-changeset` is correct, since `docs/adr/**` ships in no released package and the diff publishes nothing. `Check Changeset` is `skipped` on this head, as the label intends.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty in both dev reports. Nothing to answer.
- **PR body describes the earlier head b234dce486** (dev deviation, report 7211137072): answered, not a finding against the contract. The contract is the tree, and the tree is right. The body is not in the diff and no gate reads the stale statements (`PR-body guards` is `success` on this head). It is a body correction owed at the hand-off, because the maintainer reads the body and it may become the merge message. Statements to bring forward: the "after" cell (now `…amended 2026-11-25, 2…`); the Cause bullet (the status line is the one 031a19dcfd wrote); the head sha (49760721ca) and `main` sha; the idempotence blob (ef06360678); the clip position (inside `, 2026-11-26 and 2026-11-27`); "the branch carries no merge commit" (it carries 031596331e); the three folded log blocks.
- Merge commit 031596331e of `main` c826e8a156 instead of a rebase: accepted. The net diff against `main` is the one file.
- Footer and branch-name deviations (harness footer; `claude/area-o1C-37733` instead of the `claude/issue` form): no effect on the contract; the branch is the one the claim names.
- Out-of-scope note, "the index goes stale with nothing red because its check is report-only": noted, not filed, and correctly so. It is the ruled behaviour, seen twice on ADR-0160 within a day. Whether to revisit that ruling is the maintainer's; no escalation is owed by this card.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, no query or code in the diff.

### ④ Design judgment

`docs/adr/README.md` — the file is generator output and the change holds against the code it comes from (`statusCell()` and `cell()` in `scripts/adr-index.mjs`) and against its source of truth (the ADR-0160 `**Status**:` line), as shown in ①. Card acceptance, "`adr:index` regenerated on main; its check passes with no other index change": met on this head. The row is not hand-edited: it equals the generator's projection character for character.

Tried to break it: a hand-trimmed cell (no, the clip lands exactly at 63 characters plus the ellipsis); a second stale row hidden behind the report-only check (no, no other record's header fields changed since the last index write); a head that `main` has already overtaken (no, no record or generator change after the base).

No must-fix, no should-fix.

Observation, not a finding on this diff: the visible cell does not show the newer amendment dates, because the generator clips the status cell at 64 characters. That is the generator's behaviour, outside this diff.
